crossrefs.text: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High—
He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego will be cut into pieces and their houses reduced to rubble. For there is no other god who can deliver in this way.”
When you make a vow to God, do not delay in fulfilling it, because He takes no pleasure in fools. Fulfill your vow.
Do not let your mouth cause your flesh to sin, and do not tell the messenger that your vow was a mistake. Why should God be angry with your words and destroy the work of your hands?
Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.
Then Jehoshaphatʼs kingdom was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.
Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
“I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
